spec.name: Blade Revolver
spec.description: A Final Fantasy style gunblade planted tip-down in the ground: a great glowing-edged sword blade rising out of a revolver gun-housing with a curved leather grip and a lion-headed guard.
spec.layout: The gunblade stands upright, planted on its blade tip like a monument, leaning very slightly so the tip touches the floor at z +0.12 and the hilt sits back at z -0.05. Front view (+Z) reads the blade's wide flat face: dark gunmetal steel with a brighter steel mid-band, a cyan glowing fuller stripe running the whole length beside the cutting edge, and engraved rune marks down the flat. The cutting edge runs down the left side (+X) with a fine lit edge line; the spine on the right (+X negative) is heavier with gold trim bolts. At the top, the blade enters the revolver gun-housing (y 1.95 to 2.25): a chunky dark iron block with a brass revolver drum around the blade root whose axis is vertical, six chamber bores facing forward, a short barrel stub and a front sight above the blade exit, and an ink-outlined panelled surface with rivets. Back from the housing the grip curves down and back to z -0.5, wrapped in red leather bands with gold studs, ending in a gold lion-headed pommel whose mane reads from the front. A large gold crossguard with a lion-head emblem faces forward at the blade root, with a hanging gold chain draping down the blade's spine side. Trigger and trigger guard hang on the right side (-X) of the housing. Style everywhere is bold low-poly FF metalwork: every stripe, stud, rune and emblem is its own small flat-coloured part seated on the surface, cyan glow on the blade edge and chamber bores.

parts.builds: The great blade from its planted tip at y 0 up to the gun-housing mount at y 1.95. Built as a low-poly frustum blade in the x-y plane, flat faces front and back, widest at the guard (about 0.3 m) tapering to a point at the tip which touches the floor (the only floor contact, sunk at most 2%). Left side carries the cutting edge: a narrow bright steel bevel strip running the full length, backed by a cyan glow edge stripe (use the glow kit) that reads from the front. Right side is the blunt spine, thicker, with small gold trim bolts spaced along it. Centre flat wears a darker gunmetal field with a brighter steel mid-band and a column of engraved rune marks: each rune a small dark ink part seated flat on the blade face, five or six down the length, plus a gold diamond emblem near the base. Back face mirrors the front's edge and spine treatment more simply. Tip area is a lighter worn steel. Blade leans slightly in z so the tip sits forward at z +0.12.
parts.attaches: Blade base enters the revolver drum at mount bladeRoot and passes behind the crossguard at guardPlane; the housing and guard parts clamp around it there.

parts.builds: The revolver gun-housing block sitting on top of the blade root, y 1.95 to 2.3, plus the revolver drum and barrel. Iron-dark frustum block with ink panel seams and small rivet studs (own small parts). A brass revolver drum of about 0.16 m radius wraps the blade root, axis vertical through mount cylinderCentre, riding the cylinderSpin joint, with six round chamber bores drilled facing forward on its front face: each bore a dark recess ring with a cyan glow interior so they light up. Above the drum a short thick barrel stub continues up past the blade root with a flat muzzle ring, and a gold front sight post stands on its front. Top of the block carries a small iron hammer/spur fin and gold cap. Panelled metal look via small plate parts in gunmetal against the ironDark body; every fitting in goldTrim or bronze.
parts.attaches: Sits on the blade top at bladeRoot and around mount cylinderCentre; grip attaches behind at gripRoot, guard meets its underside.

parts.builds: The crossguard and all heraldry at the blade root. A large gold crossguard spanning x -0.42 to 0.42 at y 1.92 to 2.02, slightly winged upward at both tips, layered: dark bronze under-plate, goldTrim main plate, goldBright beaded trim running its rim as small stud parts. On its front face a bold lion-head emblem facing +Z: a circular goldBright medallion with a stylized lion face built from small cream, ink and lionGold parts (muzzle, mane spikes, eyes) so it reads clearly from the front. A fine gold chain of small link spheres drapes from the guard's left tip down along the blade spine to about y 1.2. Small gold filigree wings spread back over the housing sides.
parts.attaches: Clamps the blade at guardPlane and the housing underside at bladeRoot; wraps around mount cylinderCentre's front.

parts.builds: The curved grip and trigger assembly. The grip is a chunky swept handle from mount gripRoot at the housing's back curving down and back to about y 1.62 at z -0.5, built as a segmented low-poly curve of brownGrip core wrapped in redLeather bands separated by thin dark redLeatherDark gaps, each band studded with small gold studs down its sides. Pommel at the grip's end: a goldBright lion-head cap with mane blades flaring down and back, facing the viewer's front-right so it reads from +Z, with a small hanging gold tassel loop. On the right side of the housing (-X): a rounded ink trigger-guard loop swept from the housing down around the trigger, a redLeather trigger blade inside riding the triggerHinge joint with a gold hinge pin, and a small gold side-plate emblem where the guard meets the housing.
parts.attaches: Grip root joins the housing back at gripRoot; trigger guard and trigger hang from the housing's right flank at the core and triggerHinge joints.
